text:
Alyssa (People Ops): Quick heads-up — we've updated the international travel per-diem and clarified meal reimbursement rules. Effective for trips starting on 2026-06-01. Full policy here: https://redwood.atlassian.org/people-ops/travel/per-diem-2026 

Travel-Expenses-Bot: New per-diem rates uploaded. Auto-conversion uses XE daily rate; receipts required for items over 25 USD equivalent.

Jamal Carter: Thanks Alyssa — are partner/guest meals covered if I'm traveling for customer dinner?

Alyssa (People Ops): Short answer: yes, but only when guest is a customer or vendor and the expense is business-related. Please mark as "client entertainment" in the expense form and include names.

Emma Li: For local-currency receipts, do we need to show USD conversion on the receipt or can I just upload the original?

Alyssa (People Ops): Upload the original. Our finance tool will apply the conversion. If you want to add a note, include the exchange rate you used.

Ravi Patel: Any changes to the meal per-diem caps? Last time I fought with the cardholder about breakfast + coffee being double-counted.

Alyssa (People Ops): We clarified aggregation rules. Per-diem is per calendar day per traveler. Incidental items (snacks/coffee under ~10 USD) are allowed without receipts but will be aggregated against the daily cap.

Jamal Carter: What about vendor card charges — do we still need employee receipts if the company card was used?

Alyssa (People Ops): If a Redwood card was used, attach the corporate card charge and add a short justification. No duplicate personal receipt needed unless the vendor requires it for reconciliation.

Emma Li: Nicely done. Will retroactive trips be adjusted? I had a trip starting May 28.

Alyssa (People Ops): Retroactive adjustments: only for active trips that overlap the effective date and if you submit within 30 days of policy change. Send an email to people-ops@redwood.com with subject line "Retro Per-Diem Request" and include dates + expenses.

Ravi Patel: Quick upload help? The mobile app sometimes rejects JPGs.

Alyssa (People Ops): For uploads, prefer PDF or PNG. If you must use JPG, make sure it's > 500x500 px and the merchant name/date are legible. Example expense form fields:

```
Expense Type: Travel > Meals > Client Entertainment
Amount: 78.50 EUR
Business Purpose: Dinner with ACME product team
Guests: John Doe (ACME)
Receipt: attach PDF/PNG
```
Travel-Expenses-Bot: Reminder: receipts over 25 USD equivalent will trigger an automated verification step.

Jamal Carter: Thanks — super clear. Will there be a short walkthrough?

Alyssa (People Ops): Yes — I'll run a 30-minute drop-in session next Wednesday 11:00 PT in #people-ops-office-hours. Also updating the FAQ in the policy doc with examples. :calendar: :thumbsup:

Emma Li: Going to attend. Cheers.

Ravi Patel: Thanks Alyssa!

Alyssa (People Ops): Thanks everyone — ping me if you hit problems uploading or converting receipts.
